structure.unit: General Provisions; Charters; Other Forms and Organization of Counties
Urban County Executive Form of Government

law.catch_line: Certain officers not affected by adoption of plan
law.text:
The following officers shall not, except as herein otherwise provided, be affected by the adoption of the urban county executive form:
Jury commissioners,
County electoral boards,
Registrars,
Judges and clerks of elections, and
Magistrates.
